name: Pulses
description: Two soft gates pulse the sound on one pattern, the second a little faster, so the two patterns drift apart and come back together.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How fast the steps go by. Slow gives long swells with long gaps; at the top a full pattern blurs into a flutter while a sparse one is still a rhythm.

params.name: Steps
params.description: How many steps the pattern has before it comes round again.

params.name: Fill
params.description: How many of the steps sound, spread as evenly as they will go. More than Steps is all of them.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How much faster the second gate runs, so its pattern slides against the first and comes back round, sooner the higher it is set. At zero the two stay together.

params.name: Shift
params.description: Starts the second gate this many steps ahead of the first, a fixed canon between the two. Drift moves on from there.

params.name: Shade
params.description: Dulls the sound as each pulse closes, so the pulses open bright out of a darker bed. At zero only the level moves.

params.name: Apart
params.description: Where the two gates sit. At zero both pulse in the middle; at full the first is on the left and the second on the right.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the untouched signal and the pulsed one. Lower settings make the pulses shallower.

params.name: Accent
params.description: Turns down every step but the first, so the start of the pattern stands out and the slide between the two gates is easier to follow.

params.name: Edge
params.description: The shape of each pulse. Low swells in and out over the whole pulse; high cuts in and out like a chop.

params.name: Length
params.description: How much of its step each pulse lasts. Short leaves air between the pulses; at full each pulse ends as the next begins.

params.name: Floor
params.description: How much of the sound is left between pulses. At zero the gaps are silent; turned up, the pulses ride on a bed of the sound, and at full only Shade still moves.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Two gates on one evenly spread pattern, the second a little faster, after the phasing of minimal music; no unit or plug-in is modelled.
